# Psalm 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Upon Muth-labben. A-psalm of-David.

**2** I-will-give-thanks [to] YHWH with-all my-heart; I-will-recount all Your-wonders.

**3** I-will-be-glad and-exult in-You; I-will-sing-praise [to] Your-name, O-Most-High.

**4** When-my-enemies turn back, they-stumble and-perish from-before-You.

**5** For You-have-maintained my-justice and-my-cause; You-sat on-the-throne judging righteously.

**6** You-have-rebuked the-nations, You-have-destroyed the-wicked; their-name You-have-blotted-out forever and-ever.

**7** The-enemy — finished [are] the-ruins forever; and-cities You-have-uprooted — perished [is] their-memory.

**8** But-YHWH sits forever; He-has-established for-judgment His-throne.

**9** And-He judges the-world in-righteousness; He-renders-judgment [to] the-peoples in-uprightness.

**10** And-YHWH is a-stronghold for-the-oppressed, a-stronghold in-times of-distress.

**11** And-those-who-know Your-name trust in-You, for You-have-not forsaken those-who-seek-You, YHWH.

**12** Sing-praises to-YHWH, the-One-dwelling in-Zion; declare among-the-peoples His-deeds.

**13** For the-One-avenging blood remembers them; He-does-not forget the-cry of-the-afflicted.

**14** Be-gracious to-me, YHWH; see my-affliction from-those-who-hate-me, the-One-lifting-me from-the-gates of-death,

**15** so-that I-may-recount all Your-praises in-the-gates of-the-daughter of-Zion; I-will-rejoice in-Your-salvation.

**16** The-nations have-sunk in-the-pit they-made; in-the-net which they-hid, their-foot is-caught.

**17** YHWH is-known; judgment He-has-done. By-the-work of-his-own-hands the-wicked is-snared. Higgaion. Selah.

**18** The-wicked shall-return to-Sheol, all the-nations that-forget God.

**19** For not forever shall-the-needy be-forgotten, [nor] the-hope of-the-afflicted perish forever.

**20** Arise, YHWH! Let-not man prevail; let-the-nations be-judged before-Your-face.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **9:1**: Muth-labben — possibly 'death of the son,' a tune name. The meaning is debated.

- **9:17**: Higgaion — a musical term, possibly meaning 'meditation' or a soft, murmured musical interlude.

— EMET
